title: Recap: LLMs are General Purpose models
reading: A recap slide summarizing three senses in which LLMs are general-purpose, laid out as three icon-labelled columns: generality of architecture, generality of concepts across skills, and generality of learning. Each column pairs an icon with a short italic gloss.

visuals.description: Three columns, each with an icon (a node/tree graph; a wrench crossed with a pencil; a teacher at a blackboard with students) above a heading and italic caption.
visuals.assertion: LLM generality has three facets: the architecture/system supports a wide range of tasks; the model performs tasks of unseen skill-concept combinations; and it learns new tasks efficiently from descriptions and in-context examples.

concepts.name: Generality of architecture
concepts.why_it_matters: One system handles many tasks without task-specific redesign.

concepts.name: Generality of concepts across skills
concepts.why_it_matters: Compositional generalization to unseen skill-concept pairings.

concepts.name: Generality of learning / in-context learning
concepts.why_it_matters: New tasks acquired from prompts rather than retraining.

verbatim_spans: Performs tasks of unseen skill-concept combinations
Learning new tasks efficiently via descriptions and in-context examples
